fullPassage: The average person’s belief about themselves is, in general, flattering. A large majority of the public believe that they are more intelligent and fair-minded, better describers and less prejudiced than the average person. This is as true of the general public as it is of university students and their professors. This set of beliefs is known as the ‘Lake Wobegon’ effect, after a fictional community in the stories by Garrison Keillor, where all the children are above average. Again, a survey of high school seniors in the USA found that 70 percent thought they had above-average leadership qualities and only 2 percent believed they were below the average. And of university professors, 94 percent thought they were better at their jobs than their average colleague.

✅ ② 일반 대중 + 대학생 + 교수 → 원문 S3 'as true of the general public as it is of university students and their professors' → 일치
❌ ④ '2%가 평균 이상이라고 생각' → 원문: 70%가 평균 이상, 2%가 평균 이하 → 수치 역전 불일치
✅ ③ Garrison Keillor 이야기 속 fictional community 이름 → 원문 S4와 일치
det.tip: 70% = above-average leadership 생각. 2% = below average 생각. 진술 ③은 이 둘을 역전시킴 → 불일치.

ch: 가리슨 케일러의 이야기에 나오는 허구의 공동체 이름이 이 효과의 명칭에 사용되었다.
자신에 대한 평균적인 사람의 믿음은 대체로 자기 자신에게 우호적인 방향으로 형성된다.
이 현상은 일반 대중뿐 아니라 대학생과 교수들에게도 동일하게 나타난다.
미국 고등학교 3학년 학생 중 단 2%만이 자신의 지도력이 평균 이상이라고 생각했다.

questions.passage: The average person’s belief about themselves is, in general, flattering. A large majority of the public ③<u>believe</u> that they are more intelligent and ④<u>fair-minded</u>, ①<u>better describing</u> and less prejudiced than the average person. This is as true of the general public as it is of university students and their professors. This set of beliefs is known as the ‘Lake Wobegon’ effect, after a fictional community in the stories by Garrison Keillor, where all the children are ②<u>above average</u>. Again, a survey of high school seniors in the USA found that 70 percent thought they had above-average leadership qualities and only 2 percent believed they were below the average. And of university professors, 94 percent thought they were better at their jobs than their average colleague.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ better describing → better describers: 원문 'they are more intelligent and fair-minded, better describers and less prejudiced'에서 병렬 구조는 형용사/명사의 나열. better describers(명사 병렬)가 맞음. better describing은 동명사/현재분사로 형용사 병렬 구조를 깨뜨림.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ believe: A large majority of the public(복수) + believe → 수일치 정상
✅ ② fair-minded: more intelligent and fair-minded → 형용사 병렬 정상
❌ ① better describing: 원문 병렬 구조 'more intelligent … fair-minded … better describers … less prejudiced' → 명사 describers 필요. describing(동명사/분사) 삽입 시 병렬 파괴
✅ ③ above average: 평균 이상의 → 형용사구 정상
det.tip: 병렬 구조: more intelligent / fair-minded / better describers / less prejudiced → 형용사/명사 나열. describing은 병렬 파괴.
